describe_image_with_vision swallows all exceptions silently — fine by design but log.exception calls help; the helper is robust against missing key, empty bytes, network failures, and bad parse — confirmed by 5 unit tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend login flow: OTP is server-side dev_otp returned in /api/auth/login JSON when needs_otp=true. Easiest path is to call /api/auth/login + /api/auth/verify-otp from page.evaluate() and stash access_token in localStorage under keys: sawali_token, token, access_token, then navigate. The OTP UI does NOT display the code on the login screen (only on Espace Loois pre-auth landing); the message 'code OTP affiché directement sur la page' refers to the dev_otp field in the API response, not a UI rendering. QdrantRagSection lives in AdminSettings at anchor #s-qdrant-rag; to expose qdrant-tab-image you must first open/select a collection (workspace tabs only render when activeCollection is set). For Playwright, easier to validate via code review or by directly calling backend image endpoint (which is what we tested with auto_describe=on/off).
